tools.name: create_video_link
tools.description:
Build a one-tap link that makes a short vertical AI video of a character doing what the user describes (e.g. "Malfoid dances on the castle roof at midnight").
Use this whenever the user asks for an AI video, short, clip, TikTok/Reel/Shorts-style video, or animation of a character, avatar, mascot or persona.
Returns a URL on malfoid.tv/cast. Give the URL to the user and tell them to open it: it shows the scene and opens Cast, where a pass holder films it in Create. This tool does NOT generate anything, charge anything or need an account. Filming takes a pass. Only characters returned by list_characters are supported premade cast for this flow; other cast members appear on story cards. Longer videos and custom characters cost credits (from $0.99).
For a premade character pass character="malfoid" (or "malfoid,leo" for up to 3). For anyone else pass character_name and character_description (their look) instead; the user designs the character before the video.

prompt.description: What happens in the video, one line in plain words, present tense, without the character's name at the start. Concrete action + place works best: "dances on the castle roof at midnight", "reads her hate comments live and claps back".

character.description: Premade character slug(s), comma-separated, up to 3: malfoid, leo. Omit when using character_name/character_description.

character_name.description: Name of a NEW character to design (not one of the premade slugs).

character_description.description: The new character's look in one or two sentences: age, hair, face, clothes, vibe. Required for a good result when character_name is set.

style.description: Visual style. influencer: Phone-camera real; cinematic: Feature-film look; sakuga: Hand-painted anime action; glam: Fashion-week polish; vhs: Camcorder nostalgia; vlog: Warm everyday diary; dark-fantasy: Gothic myth & magic; toon3d: Animated-feature charm. Default influencer.

camera.description: Camera. auto: Let it decide; selfie: Phone-POV one-take; close-up: Faces fill the frame; wide: Big world, small figures; handheld: Breathing operator; push-in: Slow dolly in; chase: Tracking at speed; low-angle: Hero from below; overhead: God's-eye view; held: Locked-off frame. Default selfie (phone-POV livestream).

vibe.description: Mood and pacing. chill: Warm, low stakes; hype: Kinetic energy; dreamy: Soft and floating; eerie: Quiet dread; melancholy: Rain and distance; romantic: Tender and close; epic: Enormous scale; comedy: Snappy timing; fury: Rage with weight. Default hype.

seconds.description: Length in seconds. Live generation is paid; up to 10 without Premium; 15 needs Premium.

tools.name: list_characters
tools.description: List the premade characters Cast can put in a video (slug, name, look, image, whether free), plus how to design a custom one. Call before create_video_link when you need a character slug or want to show the user who they can cast. Read-only, no account.

tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: Current Cast prices in USD and credits: weekly Season 1 passes, agent credit packs, Premium, and the credit cost of every video length and of a new character. Prices follow the live model price table, so call this instead of quoting from memory. Read-only.

tools.name: get_showcase
tools.description: Example videos of Cast characters (video URL, poster image, the line that produced it when on record, page link, and a ready-made remix link). Use to show the user what Cast makes before they open a link, or to find a proven prompt to adapt. Read-only.
